should_block_tag_reason: All 5 P0 gaps are coverage improvements and hardening follow-ups, not regressions. The 4 xfail tests (F-01a, F-01b, F-02, F-03) are actively tracked known-gaps documented across R2/R3/Pre-Tag rounds; they do not represent new or undiscovered defects. The pre-tag audit round (Pre-Tag N) issued 'go_after_user_action' with full knowledge of these gaps, all 36 release gate checks pass, pytest is 1062 pass / 0 fail, ruff 0, mypy 0. No P0 gap is a regression from a previously-passing test or an unreported security finding; all are improvement opportunities for R4.
